summary: Seo-yeon's contest entry, a museum visit, an old bookstore, Byeol's pen name, a river festival, and the award ceremony.

notes.title: -기만 하다
notes.text: -기만 하다 means "just / only keep doing": 그리기만 해 (she does nothing but draw), 웃기만 하지 말고 대답해 (don't just smile — answer me). 이루다 = to achieve; 이루어지다 (or 이뤄지다) = to come true: 꿈이 이루어졌어요! (My dream came true!)

notes.title: Museums
notes.text: Seoul's 국립중앙박물관 (National Museum of Korea) and 국립현대미술관 (National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art) are excellent — and often free. Korean celadon (청자) and white porcelain (백자) are world-famous 도자기. -아/어지다 also makes passive verbs: 만들어지다 (be made), 세워지다 (be built).

notes.title: Book words
notes.text: 소설 (novel), 시 (poem), 시인 (poet), 동화 (children's story), 만화 (comic), 저자 (author), 문학 (literature), 글 (writing). Popular webtoons are often printed as books and turned into TV dramas. Many artists publish under a pen name (필명) rather than their real name.

scene.ko: 서연아! 이 웹툰 저자가 '별빛'이야. 별 씨 아닐까?
scene.en: Seo-yeon! The author of this webtoon is "Byeolbit." Could it be Byeol?

scene.ko: 별빛? 그 이름은 웹툰계에서 유명해! 그런데 나조차 진짜 이름을 몰랐어.
scene.en: Byeolbit? That name is famous in the webtoon world! But even I didn't know her real name.

notes.title: N조차 / N마저
notes.text: Both mean "even," usually in a negative or surprising situation: 나조차 몰랐어 (even I didn't know), 상마저 두고 떠났어 (she left even her prize behind). 마저 often adds "the last thing, too." For a neutral "even," use -도: 아이도 알아요 (even a child knows).

notes.title: Homonyms
notes.text: 연기 means both "acting" (演技) and "smoke" (煙氣) — Min-jun gets both at once! Music words: 악기 (instrument), 가요 (Korean pop song), 노랫소리 (the sound of singing), 리듬 (rhythm), 무용 (dance as an art form). 촬영 = filming; 출연하다 = to appear on a show.

notes.title: -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다
notes.text: -(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다 means "can't help but" or "have no choice but": 상을 받을 수밖에 없어 (she was bound to win), 걸어갈 수밖에 없었어요 (I had no choice but to walk). At award shows: 대상 (grand prize), 최우수상 (top prize), 우수상 (excellence award).
